title: stelis pilifera
intro: Stelis pilifera, commonly known as the "Rabbit's Foot Orchid", is a species of orchid native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may aid in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Stelis pilifera are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, antiviral, and antiproliferative activities. However, further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of Stelis pilifera for medicinal use.
